body:
Bumps `quinn-proto` from 0.11.15 to 0.11.17 to address the following two security issues.

[GHSA-qfwj-vfxf-92j2](https://github.com/quinn-rs/quinn/security/advisories/GHSA-qfwj-vfxf-92j2)
A memory-exhaustion guard can be bypassed

[GHSA-2hv7-gw8g-gpq5](https://github.com/quinn-rs/quinn/security/advisories/GHSA-2hv7-gw8g-gpq5)
DATAGRAM with Zero-length can bypass eviction loops
title: Bump `quinn-proto` to 0.11.17
